info.title: GeoAttend Workforce Attendance
info.description: Multi-tenant GPS geofencing attendance API. All distances and attendance decisions are computed server-side.

post.description: Submit one GPS fix from the open Attendance screen. Idempotent per event_uuid.

get.description: Current server-side state (no GPS needed) — used on page load and while offline recovery happens.
Today's sessions, temporary exits and the presence-event timeline (no coordinates).

patch.description: Admin/HR manual override (also in Automatic mode). Managers file correction requests instead.

schema.title: Response Employees Api V1 Monitoring Employees  Get

post.description: Sign in (or register a new workspace) with a Google ID token. Invited users are activated on first Google sign-in.
Rotate: each refresh token is single-use. Reusing a rotated token revokes the whole token family.

schema.title: Response List Plans Api V1 Plans  Get
Response Billing Api V1 Organizations Current Billing  Get
Response Change Plan Api V1 Organizations Current Billing  Patch
Response List Departments Api V1 Departments  Get

delete.description:
Offboard: deactivates the employee and their login, revokes tokens and devices.
Attendance history is retained for payroll/compliance (see data retention policy).

schema.title: Response List Offices Api V1 Offices  Get

delete.description: Deactivates the office and its geofence (history references it, so the row is kept).

schema.title: Response List Schedules Api V1 Schedules  Get
Response My Schedule Api V1 Schedules Me  Get
Response List Assignments Api V1 Schedules Assignments  Get
Response List Leave Api V1 Leave Requests  Get

post.description: Offline sync. Each item is validated & processed independently; one bad item never blocks the queue.

get.description: Deprecated alias of GET /monitoring/employees/ (same rows; no coordinates or trails).

schema.title: Response Uncertain Events Api V1 Locations Uncertain  Get

post.description: Periodic permission/status report. Revocation is recorded as an informational anomaly, never as absence.

schema.title: Response My Devices Api V1 Devices Me  Get

get.description: The signed-in employee's attendance for the current shift (live working time).
Sessions awaiting manager approval for employees the caller may review.

schema.title: Response Pending Approvals Api V1 Attendance Approvals  Get
Response Team Today Api V1 Attendance Today Team  Get
Response List Corrections Api V1 Attendance Corrections  Get

post.description: Employee disputes an automatically recorded attendance. Totals change only after a reviewer approves.
HR helper: materialise a record for a scheduled day (e.g. LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE) so a correction can be filed against it.

schema.title: Response List Anomalies Api V1 Anomalies  Get
Response My Notifications Api V1 Notifications  Get

GpsActionIn.title: GpsActionIn
GpsActionIn.description: Browser Geolocation reading for an explicit check-in / check-out. Distance and status are computed server-side.

LocationEventIn.title: LocationEventIn
LocationEventIn.description:
Raw fix from a device. Range checks happen server-side in the engine so that batches
can reject individual items instead of failing as a whole. Distance/zone/status are never accepted.

max_accuracy.title: Max Accuracy
max_accuracy.description: Maximum acceptable GPS accuracy in metres

PresenceCheckIn.title: PresenceCheckIn
PresenceCheckIn.description: One browser GPS fix. Zone, distance and attendance are always computed by the server.
